note: Central thresholds for the lesson→video generation loop. Edit here, not in code.

duration.why: 15:00–25:00 inclusive; target 18:00. Measured from the RENDERED output.

sync.why: The timeline is derived from REAL audio-beat durations, so structural drift is ~0. This tolerance only guards render/encode rounding. A segment fails above it.

audio.why: Trim only leading/trailing dead air; NEVER internal repetition pauses (those are intentional silent beats in the timeline).

quality.rubric: Each dimension scored 0–10. Deterministic where possible; subjective ones are flagged as such in the report.

pronunciation.why: auto = transcribe each FR clip and match it to the intended card text WHEN an STT backend is available (OPENAI_API_KEY, openai-whisper, or whisper.cpp). With no backend the gate is needs-review — UNVERIFIED, never a false pass. Set false to skip entirely; true to require a backend.
